description:
Days_to_Correlate:  How far back to look for SIG records to correlate, in days. Default 1.
Correlations_to_Return: Max correlated records to return to a given SIG record when correlations are found.  Default 10. Setting higher may impact record CRUD performance.
Minimum_String_Match_Ratio: How closely two strings in a SIG record must match in order to be considered a hit. Set to 1 to disable fuzzy matching and require 100% string match. Range 0-1. Default 1.
Minimum_Record_Match_Ratio: How closely two records must match to be considered a hit. Range 0-1. Default 0.75.
Correlation_Delay_Minutes: How long after a SIG record is written it will be available for correlation, in minutes. This allows for better correlation of fast-influx alerts.  Default 5.
Maximum_Records_to_Search: How many SIG records to compare against the current record.  Default 1000.  Max 5000.
name: AI_SOC_Correlation_Configuration
title: AI SOC Correlation Configuration
